Authenticity 0.3.0: writing checks for Obsidian that run on your own computer.

- **AI-writing check** with SlopTotal, a local detector, on one scale from 0 (reads as written by a person) to 100 (reads as AI), with the detectors' reasons, sentence scores and model-free hints. Optionally GPTZero, with your own API key, chosen for each check.
- **Plagiarism check** against a library folder of your source notes: copied wording, the field's fixed phrasing listed apart, and close paraphrases found by a search over the library's words (no model). The paraphrase closeness can be reset to its default in the Plagiarism pane.
- **Reveal AI characters**: hidden and look-alike characters, replaced one at a time or for a selection.
- **A live log pane** in the settings (Logs).

The plugin's files are `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css`. The AI-writing check also needs the helper program from the [native release](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/releases/tag/native-0.3.0) and SlopTotal: see [Installation](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/blob/main/docs/installation.md). Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this tag and attested: `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/authenticity`.

Disclosures (network use, files outside the vault, payment): [docs/disclosures.md](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/authenticity/blob/main/docs/disclosures.md).
